aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab was founded by Dominic Bonini, who created Village Foodie to know which food trucks would be coming to his village. It is a small company and he runs it himself.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.hatchgrab: The more food trucks I got to know, the more I thought they deserved better tools: something designed for a business that is somewhere different every day, not for a restaurant with a fixed address. That is why I founded HatchGrab.
aboutPage.story.small: It is a small company and I run it. If you write to us, I will reply to you, not a support queue.
aboutPage.story.village: I live in a small village. Food trucks come by, but I never knew which one would come, or when, without having to dig around on Facebook.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: So I created Village Foodie, a simple way to see which food trucks are coming to villages near you.

featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order ahead for a future date or time, before the event.
featuresPage.detail.advanced_reporting: Analyse sales by period, dish and event to understand what really sells.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm them one by one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to the QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Link a buzzer number to an order when you give it to the customer, so you know which buzzer matches which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen visible to customers that shows the order numbers and when they are ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on the HatchGrab public map, so customers nearby can find you.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your website. Each one leads directly to its ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with custom prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The most complete way to use HatchGrab: a real-time kitchen screen, and the only way to keep taking orders when you lose signal.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can cook at a time and how long it takes. When a time slot is full, customers can no longer choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward regular customers with digital loyalty cards — stamps collected and rewards redeemed automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Group dishes into combo meals and offer extras at payment time to raise the average receipt.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: Like WhatsApp auto-replies, for questions from Messenger and Instagram.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — counter and kitchen — all showing the same orders in real time.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give your staff personal logins with the right level of permissions.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If you lose signal, online orders pause, so customers can’t send orders you wouldn’t see. The app for iPhone, iPad and Android lets you keep taking orders offline; the web dashboard requires a connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Take card payment in advance when customers order online, via Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a cut-off time for dishes that need notice.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that don’t appear on the map, with a private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and the ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your website or from a photo you already post on Facebook. You check and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Automatically notify customers by SMS when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we automatically add dates, places and times for every week and every event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any dish as sold out with one tap — for customers it turns grey straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set an available quantity: it goes down with each order and, when it reaches zero, the dish shows as sold out automatically.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Accept card payments on a compatible phone, without needing a separate card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print kitchen tickets on a Bluetooth or cabled printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a collection time slot, so demand spreads across the whole service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the counter, paid on your card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run the service from the browser of any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: WhatsApp auto-replies to questions about your menu and your schedule.

landing.does.devicesBody: Works on the phone in your apron, on the tablet on the counter, on the laptop in the food truck — and on the card terminal you already take payments with.
landing.does.lede: Most online ordering systems take for granted a fixed address, reliable Wi-Fi and the same hours every week. You, instead, are somewhere different every week, at different times, with poor or no mobile coverage. HatchGrab was born for this.
landing.does.offlineBody: If you lose signal, online orders pause automatically, so customers can’t send orders you wouldn’t see. Keep taking orders with the app for iPhone, iPad and Android.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already publish on Facebook or Instagram. We insert dates, places and times, ready to share — every week or every day.
landing.does.postsTitle: Automate your Facebook and Instagram posts
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and choose a collection time. Fewer queues and food ready on their arrival.
landing.does.title: Designed for food trucks, not for restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Your WhatsApp replies while you drive to the pitch or are at the griddle, using your menu and your schedule. Messenger and Instagram coming soon.
